text: brief document present general function valuate actuarial liabilities normal costs, allowing different methods pension funding defined benefit schemes. method defined way contributions accrued active age specific risk apply. Following (Winklevoss 1993) (Bowers et al. 1997), Normal Cost Actuarial Liability can seen portions PVFNCxrPVFNC^{r}_x, present value future benefit age xx risk rr, ’s way treat function’s code. methods implemented “Benefit Prorate Method, Constant Dollar”, “Benefit Prorate Method, Constant Percent”, “Cost Prorate Method, Constant Dollar” “Cost Prorate Method, Constant Benefit” (last two also called “entry age methods”). formula details reader can go chapters 5 6 (Winklevoss 1993). define general function allows perform calculations multi-decrement environment, flexibility consider different kind benefit scheme, using functions “lifecontingencies” package (Spedicato et. al., 2018). arguments (following general notation Gian Paolo Clemente’s vignette titled “Pension Funding lifecontingencies”) : xx: age insured time valuation yy: age person entered job. age usually different age plan began rr: age risk evaluated acttableAccPeriodacttableAccPeriod: multi-decrement object lifetable, one decrements risk interest. One common applications obligated retirement age rr, even case needed multi-decrement table risks death retirement (certainty age rr) decrementdecrement: decrement evaluate ii: interest rate (real) jj: salary rate increment (real, productivity seniority included) deltadelta: benefit rate increment (real) nn: years benefit payed (can 1 single payments). omitted, take value ω−r\omega-r avgavg: number past salaries considered average acttablePaymPeriodacttablePaymPeriod: lifetable object payment period CostMetCostMet: Method Cost, “BPM_CD” (Benefit Prorate Method, Constant Dollar), “BPM_CP” (Benefit Prorate Method, Constant Percent), “CPM_CD” (Cost Prorate Method, Constant Dollar), “CPM_CB” (Cost Prorate Method, Constant Benefit). general function :
code: require("lifecontingencies") PensFund <- function(x, y, r, acttableAccPeriod, decrement, i, j, delta, n, avg,     acttablePaymPeriod, CostMet) {     if (missing(n))         n <- getOmega(acttableAccPeriod) - x - 1     if (x < y)         stop("Entry age greater than actual age")     if (missing(decrement))         stop("Which is the contingency of benefit?")     if (class(acttableAccPeriod) != "mdt")         stop("Error! Needed Mdt")     if (!(decrement %in% getDecrements(acttableAccPeriod)))         stop("Error! Not recognized decrement type")     if (missing(acttableAccPeriod))         stop("Error! Need a lifetable or actuarialtable")     if (missing(x) | missing(y))         stop("Error! Need age and seniority!")     if (x > getOmega(acttableAccPeriod)) {         out = 0         return(out)     }     if (missing(CostMet))         CostMet = "BPM_CD"     if (missing(avg))         stop("Error! Need avg period of computing benefit")     if (missing(j))         stop("Error! Need average salary increase rate")     if (any(x < 0, y < 0, avg < 0, delta < 0))         stop("Error! Negative parameters")      ########## survive all casuses     acttableAccPeriodTotal = pxt(acttableAccPeriod, x = 0:(getOmega(acttableAccPeriod)),         t = 1)     acttableAccPeriodTotal = probs2lifetable(acttableAccPeriodTotal, type = "px")     if (missing(acttablePaymPeriod))         acttablePaymPeriod = acttableAccPeriodTotal      ########## Set benefit fix age valuation     x0 = x     B = ifelse(avg == 0, 1, (1 + j)^(r - x0) * annuity(j, avg, m = 0, k = 1, type = "immediate")/avg)     q.r = qxt(object = acttableAccPeriod, x = r, t = 1, decrement = decrement)     Br = q.r * axn(acttablePaymPeriod, r, i = (1 + i)/(1 + delta) - 1, n = n, k = 1) *         B      ########## Actuarial liability in age x, fot the age r (r>=x)     ALyNC.x.r = function(x, r) {          ## PVFB          PVFB.x = Exn(acttableAccPeriodTotal, x, r - x, i = i) * Br          ## Normal Costs and liabilities under Actuarial Cost Methods          if (CostMet == "BPM_CD") {             K <- (x - y)/(r - y)             k <- 1/(r - y)         }          if (CostMet == "BPM_CP") {             K <- (1 + j)^(x - x0) * annuity(j, x - y + 1, m = 0, k = 1, type = "immediate")/((1 +                 j)^(r - x0) * annuity(j, r - y + 1, m = 0, k = 1, type = "immediate"))             k <- (1 + j)^(x - x0)/(annuity(j, r - y, m = 0, k = 1, type = "immediate") *                 (1 + j)^(r - x0))         }          if (CostMet == "CPM_CD") {             K <- axn(acttableAccPeriodTotal, y, i = i, n = x - y, k = 1)/axn(acttableAccPeriodTotal,                 y, i = i, n = r - y, k = 1)             k <- Exn(acttableAccPeriodTotal, y, x - y, i = i)/axn(acttableAccPeriodTotal,                 y, i = i, n = r - y, k = 1)         }          if (CostMet == "CPM_CB") {             K <- axn(acttableAccPeriodTotal, y, i = (1 + i)/(1 + j) - 1, n = x -                 y, k = 1)/axn(acttableAccPeriodTotal, y, i = (1 + i)/(1 + j) - 1,                 n = r - y, k = 1)             k <- Exn(acttableAccPeriodTotal, y, x - y, i = i) * (1 + j)^(x - y)/axn(acttableAccPeriodTotal,                 y, i = (1 + i)/(1 + j) - 1, n = r - y, k = 1)         }          ## Results          outAL.x.r <- PVFB.x * K         outNC.x.r <- PVFB.x * k         outPVFB.x <- PVFB.x         out.x.r <- c(outAL.x.r, outNC.x.r, outPVFB.x)          return(out.x.r)     }      ######## AL y NC for the rest of ages      ages_risk = x:r     outAL.x = sapply(ages_risk, function(x) ALyNC.x.r(x, r)[1])     outNC.x = sapply(ages_risk, function(x) ALyNC.x.r(x, r)[2])     outPVFB.x = sapply(ages_risk, function(x) ALyNC.x.r(x, r)[3])     outNC.x[length(ages_risk)] = NA     out.x <- data.frame(x = ages_risk, AL = outAL.x, NC = outNC.x, PVFB = outPVFB.x)      return(out.x) }

text: type = "curtate" function returns (temporary) curtate expectation life $$e_{x:\overline{n}|} = \sum_{k=1}^{n} {}_k p_x ,$$ expected number complete future years lived (x) within next \(n\) years. \(n\) missing curtate expectation life \(e_x = E[K_x]\). type = "complete" function returns (temporary) complete expectation life $$\mathring{e}_{x:\overline{n}|} = \int_0^n {}_t p_x \, dt = \frac{{}_nL_x}{l_x} ,$$ evaluated uniform distribution deaths (UDD) assumption within year, .e. \(L_x = l_x - 0.5 d_x\) (see Lxt). \(n\) missing \(\mathring{e}_x = T_x / l_x = E[T_x]\). UDD two quantities related \(\mathring{e}_{x:\overline{n}|} = e_{x:\overline{n}|} + 0.5\,(1 - {}_n p_x)\), reduces \(\mathring{e}_x = e_x + 0.5\) \(n\) covers whole remaining lifespan. last tabulated age \(\omega\) treated closed interval: alive \(\omega\) assumed die average half year later. Published tables close table open interval (e.g. \(L_{\omega} = l_{\omega}/m_{\omega}\), NCHS tables) can therefore show slightly larger complete life expectancy.

text: curtate future lifetime (temporary) variance computed exactly life table $$\mathrm{Var}(\min(K_x, n)) = \sum_{k=1}^{n}(2k-1)\,{}_k p_x - \left(\sum_{k=1}^{n}{}_k p_x\right)^2 .$$ complete future lifetime variance returned whole remaining lifespan (n missing), using uniform-distribution--deaths relation \(\mathrm{Var}(T_x) = \mathrm{Var}(K_x) + 1/12\) (, UDD, \(T_x = K_x + U\) \(U\sim\mathrm{Unif}(0,1)\) independent \(K_x\)). temporary complete variance provided; use type = "Kx" temporary period.
